test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Stupas are a symbol of which of the following religions?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Buddhism**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Stupas are a symbol of **Buddhism**.
 
• They are mound-like or hemispherical structures containing relics (typically the remains of Buddhist monks or nuns) and are used as a place of meditation.
 
• The stupa serves as a significant form of Buddhist architecture and is considered a sacred structure in Buddhism.
 
• Famous stupas include the Sanchi Stupa in India, the Shwedagon Pagoda in Myanmar, and the Borobudur Stupa in Indonesia.
 
• Stupas are often decorated with carvings and statues that depict various aspects of Buddhist teachings and history.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Buddhism** was founded by Siddhartha Gautama, known as the Buddha, in the 5th century BCE in ancient India.
 
• The core teachings of Buddhism include the Four Noble Truths and the Eightfold Path, which guide individuals towards enlightenment.
 
• Buddhism emphasizes the importance of meditation, ethical conduct, and wisdom in achieving spiritual goals.
 
• There are several branches of Buddhism, including Theravada, Mahayana, and Vajrayana, each with its own unique practices and interpretations of the Buddha's teachings.
 
• Buddhism has a significant cultural and historical impact on many countries in Asia and has also spread to other parts of the world.
